newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Anderson County, Tenn..

text.p: $7,465,000 Rural Elementary School Improvement and Refunding

Notice is hereby given that the County Executive of Anderson County, Tennessee (the County'') will receive sealed bids only for the purchase of the County's $7,465,000 RURAL ELEMENTARY SCHOOL IMPROVEMENT AND REFUNDING BONDS, SERIES 1996 and $9,875,000 RURAL HIGH SCHOOL IMPROVEMENT AND REFUNDING BONDS, SERIES 1996 (collectively, the
on an all or none basis until 11:30 a.m., E.S.T., on

(or at such later time and date announced at least forty- eight hours in advance via Munifacts) at the Anderson County Executive's office in Clinton, Tennessee, at a rate or rates not exceeding six percent (6%) per annum. The Bonds will be dated November 1, 1996. The High School Bonds will mature each September 1, beginning 1998 through 2016, inclusive. The Elementary School Bonds will mature each March 1, beginning 1999 through 2017, inclusive. No bid will be accepted for less than ninety-eight and three-quarters percent (98.75%) of par and accrued interest. Unless all bids are rejected, the County Executive will award the Bonds on the sale date to the bidder whose bid results in the lowest true interest rate on the Bonds.

The Bonds are callable on March 1, 2003 and thereafter, as described in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The printed Bonds and approving opinions of Bass, Berry & Sims PLC, Nashville, Tennessee will be furnished at the expense of the County.
Additional information, including the OFFICIAL STATEMENT in near final form and the Detailed Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the undersigned at the Anderson County

Executive's Office in Clinton, Tennessee 37862 or from Cumberland Securities, Division of Morgan Keegan &Company, Inc., Suite 800, 530 South Gay Street, Knoxville, Tennessee 37902, Telephone (423) 637-1131.
